Description: Extract the key facts from a Dutch radiology report. The reports are free text written by radiologists and follow no fixed template.
Extra_Instructions: The reports are in Dutch. Give every extracted value in English, except where the value is a direct quotation from the report.

modality.description: The imaging modality used, e.g. CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiograph

body_region.description: The anatomical region imaged, as named in the report

primary_finding.description: The single most important finding, in the report's own words
